findings.detail: issuer_name is contaminated with investment class, country, instrument, industry, rate, interest-rate, and date fields instead of the source Portfolio Company cell.

rationale: The raw schedule has a separate Portfolio Company column. For the cited position, the source issuer cell is only 'Infrabuild Australia Pty Ltd', while the extracted issuer_name in the bundle includes the schedule class/country and other columns from the same row. That makes the fmt_issuer_name flag a real localized extraction defect, not a source formatting issue.
